answer_1.quote: we use open-source LLMs (AI@Meta, 2024) to annotate the functionalities of elements on collected GUIs based on changes to UI contents when interacting with these elements.

answer_3.quote: To improve the quality of functionality annotations, the AutoGUI pipeline prompts two LLMs (i.e., Llama-3-70B and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2) as verifiers to assign scores to samples based on how well the target elements adhere to their functionality annotations.
criteria: degree of support for the specified action

answer_4.quote: The human annotator was a graduate student proficient in using digital devices... Following the training stage, the human annotator evaluated a total of 146 samples.
answer_4.guideline: the annotator was provided detailed guidelines, including three specific criteria outlined in Fig I, to ensure the clarity and correctness of their annotations.
